abstract: Maintains transit fuel consumption logs and bunkering allocation records
system_message:
You are the Bunkering and Fuel Superintendent (BUNK). Your responsibilities include maintaining transit fuel consumption logs and bunkering allocation records as well as monitoring fuel tank reserve storage.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains transit fuel consumption logs and bunkering allocation records（FUEL）
information_points.content:
BUNK-FUEL-4TH：For Scylla Enterprise, the outbound mobilization fuel consumption is 120 t based on calculated marine gas oil consumed at a cruising speed of 11 knots for the transit from home base port to the North Sea offshore staging site.
BUNK-FUEL-K7C：For Boreas Titan, the outbound mobilization fuel consumption is 150 t based on calculated marine gas oil consumed at a cruising speed of 11 knots for the transit from home base port to the North Sea offshore staging site.
BUNK-FUEL-M0Q：For Volantis Pioneer, the outbound mobilization fuel consumption is 120 t based on calculated marine gas oil consumed at a cruising speed of 11 knots for the transit from home base port to the North Sea offshore staging site.

information_points.title: Fuel tank reserve storage（STOR）
information_points.content:
BUNK-STOR-0JX：For Scylla Enterprise, the usable low-sulfur fuel reserve volume across dedicated reserve storage tanks is 450 m3.
BUNK-STOR-7DE：For Volantis Pioneer, the usable low-sulfur fuel reserve volume across dedicated reserve storage tanks is 600 m3.
BUNK-STOR-P78：For Boreas Titan, the usable low-sulfur fuel reserve volume across dedicated reserve storage tanks is 300 m3.
